info.title: LinkupAPI Universal API
info.description: Search the web, fetch pages, and run research with Linkup

post.description: Creates a new research task in LinkupAPI.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

q.description: The natural-language research question to run.

outputType.description: The research response format to request.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to use in the research task.

includeImages.description: Include image results in the research context.

fromDate.description: Only consider results on or after this ISO date.

toDate.description: Only consider results on or before this ISO date.

includeDomains[].description: Restrict research sources to these domains.

excludeDomains[].description: Exclude these domains from research sources.

includeInlineCitations.description: Include inline citations when the output type is sourcedAnswer.

structuredOutputSchema.description: A JSON schema string describing the structured output to return when output type is structured.

includeSources.description: Include source metadata when using structured output.

id.description: The ID of the created research task.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.
